import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/374-9/1_374-9_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/374-9_2_3864a8a7/1_374-9_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Read Sheet1 with no header to preserve exact row/col indices
df1 = pd.read_excel(input_path, sheet_name="Sheet1", header=None)

# Header row is Excel row 6 -> pandas index 5
header = df1.iloc[5]

# Boolean masks for columns labeled 'A' or 'B'
mask_A = header == "A"
mask_B = header == "B"

cols_A = df1.columns[mask_A.fillna(False)]
cols_B = df1.columns[mask_B.fillna(False)]

# We will compute sums for Excel rows 7..22 -> pandas indices 6..21 inclusive
start_idx = 6
end_idx = 21

sums_A = []
sums_B = []
for ridx in range(start_idx, end_idx + 1):
    # select the row and the columns of interest, coerce to numeric (non-numeric -> NaN)
    rowA = pd.to_numeric(df1.loc[ridx, cols_A], errors="coerce")
    rowB = pd.to_numeric(df1.loc[ridx, cols_B], errors="coerce")
    sumA = float(rowA.sum(skipna=True)) if not rowA.empty else 0.0
    sumB = float(rowB.sum(skipna=True)) if not rowB.empty else 0.0
    sums_A.append(sumA)
    sums_B.append(sumB)

# Load workbook with openpyxl and write values into Sheet2 B7:C22 (Excel coords)
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws2 = wb["Sheet2"]

excel_row_start = 7
for i, excel_r in enumerate(range(excel_row_start, excel_row_start + len(sums_A))):
    # Column B = index 2, Column C = index 3 in Excel (openpyxl uses 'B'/'C' or numeric indices)
    ws2.cell(row=excel_r, column=2, value=sums_A[i])  # Column B
    ws2.cell(row=excel_r, column=3, value=sums_B[i])  # Column C

# Save the modified workbook
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen and print the written range B7:C22
wb2 = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
ws2b = wb2["Sheet2"]
values = []

    b_val = ws2b.cell(row=excel_r, column=2).value
    c_val = ws2b.cell(row=excel_r, column=3).value
    values.append((excel_r, b_val, c_val))

print("Written values in Sheet2 B7:C22 (row, B, C):")
